exposure: Delay in accessing final place of care (>60 minutes)
Poor birth preparedness and complication readiness
cohort: 322 women admitted to tertiary hospitals in southern Ethiopia from February 1 to June 1, 2020 (81 cases and 241 controls)
finding: The study identified inadequate antenatal care, previous C-section, delayed access to definitive care, insufficient birth preparedness, and pre-existing health conditions as significant risk factors for severe maternal health complications.
